method: Actual pinned v1/v3, neutral-season v3, and no-weak-veto v3 run for all 19 charts that were weak under v4 or prior veto-removal result, in isolated V8 module graphs; unused throwing calendar stub. All 19 observed baseline and no-veto directions checked. The candidate guards only demote weak to null, so the other 73 directions are carried from historical recorded outcomes, not rerun in this experiment. No-veto sensitivity uses recorded no-veto outputs with observed v4 strong-only gate outcomes; not a fresh full v4 no-veto execution. G4 uses neutral v3 with veto retained even in this sensitivity table; not an interaction estimate.
